power_meta.status: Fit on 1111 completed FBS games. Offense and defense ranks/grades compare rated FBS teams only; FCS opponents are excluded from the ranking pool. Previous-season scores are included when available, with recency weighting (365-day half-life). Predictions use opponent-adjusted scoring, home/neutral venue and rest/lookahead context. Early-season confidence is Low; no ATS lean without both team histories and a market spread. Confidence is qualitative and has not been calibrated as a cover probability. Every FCS opponent shares one pooled rating drawn from 222 games against FBS teams, because a single appearance cannot rate a team on its own. FCS opponents are therefore not told apart from each other. A roster-cost prior nudges the projected margin while a team has under 8 games this season (fitted this refresh at 17.3 pts per doubling of payroll, R² 0.4602); it fades to zero after that and is skipped unless both schools report a roster cost. Athletic department budgets are listed for reference and never move a spread. A penalty-tendency prior (fitted this refresh at 0.0055 pts of margin per penalty of net differential, R² 0.0 across 138 teams) nudges the margin toward whichever FBS side has drawn more calls than it has committed; weight grows with each team's penalty sample, reaching full weight at 6 games. No referee is identified anywhere in this data -- no free source ties a specific official to a specific NCAA football game -- so this tracks each team's own penalty history instead. A roster-talent prior from 247Sports' Team Talent Composite (fitted this refresh at 3.0971 rating pts per point of average player rating, R² 0.4834 across 138 teams) pulls each FBS team 20% of the way toward the rating its roster implies before it has played, fading to zero at 8 games this season.
